# What to Do in Menton on Sundays and Public Holidays

You've arrived in Menton on Saturday evening. The Mediterranean looks beautiful, the apartment is comfortable and you're ready to start exploring.

Then you remember: tomorrow is Sunday.

Will the supermarket be open? Can you buy fresh bread? Is it worth planning a restaurant dinner? And what happens if Monday is a French public holiday?

Fortunately, Menton doesn't simply shut down every Sunday. It's a living town and a tourist destination, with markets, restaurants, cafés and plenty of things to enjoy outdoors.

But opening hours are less predictable than on an ordinary weekday.

Some supermarkets close at lunchtime. Independent businesses follow different weekly schedules. Museums may have their own closing days, and public holidays can change arrangements that normally work perfectly well on Sundays.

The solution isn't to memorise a list of businesses supposedly open all year.

It's to plan the essentials in advance, verify the places that matter and build a day that doesn't depend on everything being open.

Here's how.
fr:
# Un dimanche serein à Menton

Vous arrivez le samedi soir et pensez déjà au lendemain : pain, courses, dîner, transports. Menton ne s'arrête pas le dimanche, mais les horaires d'un jour ordinaire ne suffisent pas à organiser une fête légale. Préparez l'essentiel, vérifiez les commerces importants et gardez une promenade comme solution de repli.
it:
# Una domenica tranquilla a Mentone

Arrivi sabato sera e pensi già a pane, spesa, cena e trasporti del giorno dopo. Mentone non si ferma la domenica, ma gli orari ordinari non bastano per organizzare una festività. Prepara l'essenziale, verifica i servizi importanti e conserva una passeggiata come alternativa.

# Спокійна неділя в Ментоні

Приїхали в суботу ввечері й уже думаєте про хліб, продукти, вечерю та транспорт на завтра? Ментон не зупиняється щонеділі, але звичайний розклад не гарантує роботу у свято. Підготуйте необхідне, перевірте важливі заклади й залиште прогулянку як запасний варіант.

The crucial point is that Sunday opening doesn't guarantee public-holiday opening.

A shop that normally opens every Sunday may close on Christmas Day or 1 May.

Similarly, a restaurant that serves Sunday lunch may not open for dinner.

## 2. The easiest solution: organise Saturday properly

If you're staying in an apartment, a little preparation on Saturday makes Sunday much more relaxed.

You don't need an enormous grocery shop.

Just make sure you're not depending on a particular business being open when you're hungry.

### A practical Saturday shopping list

- Bread or breakfast pastries for the following morning, if suitable for storage.

- Coffee, tea, milk and breakfast ingredients.

- Fruit, yoghurt, eggs or another simple breakfast.

- Cheese, tomatoes, olives and something for lunch.

- Ingredients for one easy dinner.

- Drinking water if you prefer bottled water.

- Snacks for children or excursions.

- Any necessary medication or personal essentials.

For a couple, a simple apartment meal could be fresh pasta, salad, bread and fruit.

For families, stocking a few familiar foods can be particularly useful if your Sunday plans change unexpectedly.

If you intend to eat out, reserve the restaurant before Sunday rather than waiting until early evening.

Our advice: Have enough food in the apartment for breakfast and one substantial meal. That gives you flexibility without forcing you to cook throughout your holiday.

## 2. Préparer simplement le samedi

Gardez de quoi prendre le petit déjeuner et préparer un vrai repas de secours : café, lait, fruits, pain adapté à la conservation, pâtes, salade et produits qui conviennent à votre famille. Ajoutez médicaments indispensables, produits pour bébé et éventuels aliments spécifiques.

Inutile de remplir l'appartement pour toute la semaine. L'objectif est de ne pas dépendre d'un commerce précis quand vous avez faim. Réservez le restaurant en amont, surtout si vous tenez au dîner. Pour un couple, pâtes, salade et fruits font un repli simple ; avec des enfants, quelques aliments familiers facilitent les changements de programme.

## 2. Prepararsi il sabato

Tieni ingredienti per colazione e un pasto completo di riserva: caffè, latte, frutta, pane adatto alla conservazione, pasta, insalata e cibi familiari. Aggiungi farmaci necessari, prodotti per bambini e alimenti specifici.

Non serve fare scorte enormi: basta non dipendere da un preciso negozio quando arriva la fame. Prenota in anticipo il ristorante, soprattutto per la cena. Pasta, insalata e frutta possono bastare per una coppia; con bambini, qualche alimento conosciuto facilita un cambio di programma. Una cena di riserva non obbliga a cucinare per tutta la vacanza.

## 2. Проста підготовка в суботу

Залиште продукти на сніданок і повноцінну запасну вечерю: каву, молоко, фрукти, придатний для зберігання хліб, пасту, салат і звичні родині продукти. Додайте необхідні ліки, дитячі товари та спеціальне харчування.

Великих запасів не потрібно: важливо не залежати від одного магазину, коли зголоднієте. Ресторан бронюйте заздалегідь, особливо на вечерю. Пасти, салату й фруктів достатньо для простої страви на двох; дітям допоможуть знайомі продукти. Запасний прийом їжі не змушує готувати всю відпустку.

## 3. Buying groceries on Sunday in Menton

Menton has more Sunday shopping options than visitors sometimes expect.

But the type of shop matters.

### Les Halles: the traditional Sunday morning option

Address: Quai de Monléon, central Menton.

The municipal covered market is one of the town's most enjoyable places for fresh food.

According to the City of Menton, the market operates every day, including Sundays, from 7:30 a.m. to 1 p.m.

You'll find traders selling fruit, vegetables, cheese, meat and other food products.

It's an excellent place to buy ingredients for a Mediterranean lunch.

However, the published market schedule doesn't mean every stall will be present every day.

Holiday schedules and individual trader absences can affect what's available.

If you need one very specific ingredient, don't rely entirely on a single market visit.

Official information: [Municipal Halles market hours](https://www.menton.fr/Marche-des-Halles-Municipales.html).

## 4. What about French public holidays?

A public holiday isn't simply another Sunday.

French law distinguishes between different types of holidays, and individual businesses may close even when they're normally open on that weekday.

Most French public holidays don't automatically require every business to close.

But 1 May, Labour Day, has special legal rules and is generally a mandatory non-working day, with exceptions for activities that cannot be interrupted.

This makes 1 May particularly important for holiday planning.

### Public holidays worth checking carefully

| Holiday | Typical date | Planning advice |
| --- | --- | --- |
| New Year's Day | 1 January | Arrange food and restaurant plans beforehand |
| Easter Monday | Varies | Expect changes to normal Monday schedules |
| Labour Day | 1 May | Plan for substantial closures |
| Victory in Europe Day | 8 May | Check shops, attractions and transport |
| Ascension Day | Varies | Popular long-weekend travel period |
| Whit Monday | Varies | Confirm individual opening hours |
| Bastille Day | 14 July | Expect celebrations, crowds and possible traffic changes |
| Assumption Day | 15 August | Busy summer holiday; reserve restaurants |
| All Saints' Day | 1 November | Verify shopping and attraction hours |
| Armistice Day | 11 November | Check reduced services and opening |
| Christmas Day | 25 December | Plan meals and essential shopping well in advance |

Easter Monday, Ascension Day and Whit Monday move from year to year.

For exact dates, consult the [French government's official holiday calendar](https://www.service-public.gouv.fr/particuliers/vosdroits/F2405).

### The special case of 1 May

If you're visiting Menton on 1 May, organise your groceries and dinner beforehand.

Don't assume that a bakery or supermarket will open just because its ordinary schedule includes Sundays or holidays.

The same caution applies to activities requiring staff, although certain essential services can continue operating.

The sea and public promenades remain attractive alternatives, subject to weather and any temporary restrictions.

## 5. Restaurants on Sunday: lunch is not the same as dinner

Sunday dining can be very enjoyable in Menton.

It's a natural day for a long Mediterranean lunch, particularly along the waterfront.

But you shouldn't assume that every restaurant serving lunch will reopen in the evening.

Some establishments have one service only, while others close on Sunday evenings or operate seasonally.

### A reliable restaurant strategy

If you want a substantial meal, consider booking Sunday lunch.

A long lunch offers time to enjoy local food without needing a late dinner reservation.

If you prefer dinner, confirm the actual Sunday evening service before making plans.

Don't rely on a restaurant's general “open Sunday” label. Look for the specific meal period and available reservation times.

### What if you haven't booked?

Start with the restaurant's official website or booking platform.

Check whether it accepts walk-ins and whether the kitchen is operating at your intended time.

If you're visiting during the Lemon Festival, a summer weekend or a French holiday weekend, availability may be more limited.

For an apartment stay, a practical backup is to keep one easy meal at home.

It means that failing to find a restaurant doesn't have to ruin the evening.

## 5. Déjeuner et dîner au restaurant

Un long déjeuner dominical peut être plus simple qu'un dîner tardif. Mais vérifiez le service choisi : « ouvert dimanche » ne signifie pas cuisine ouverte à toute heure. Certaines maisons ne servent qu'à midi ou ferment selon la saison.

Consultez le site ou le système de réservation de l'établissement. Un créneau réservable est plus utile qu'un libellé général, sans garantir que toutes les tables sont disponibles. Pour la Fête du Citron, l'été et les grands week-ends, anticipez. Sans réservation, confirmez les arrivées spontanées et l'heure de cuisine ; gardez un repas facile à l'appartement.
it:
## 5. Pranzo e cena al ristorante

Un lungo pranzo domenicale può essere più semplice di una cena tarda. Verifica però il servizio esatto: «aperto domenica» non significa cucina attiva a qualsiasi ora. Alcuni locali servono soltanto a pranzo o chiudono secondo stagione.

Consulta sito e prenotazioni del locale. Uno slot disponibile è più utile di un'etichetta generica, ma non garantisce ogni tavolo. Per Fête du Citron, estate e ponti conviene anticipare. Senza prenotazione, verifica ingressi spontanei e orario della cucina; conserva un pasto facile in appartamento.
uk:
## 5. Обід і вечеря в ресторані

Довгий недільний обід може бути простішим за пізню вечерю. Однак перевіряйте конкретний сервіс: «відкрито в неділю» не означає роботу кухні в будь-яку годину. Деякі заклади працюють лише в обід або за сезонним графіком.

Сайт і система бронювання ресторану корисніші за загальну позначку. Доступний час не гарантує всіх столиків. На Fête du Citron, улітку та в довгі вихідні плануйте раніше. Без бронювання уточніть прийом без запису й години кухні; залиште просту вечерю в апартаментах.

## 6. The best things to do in Menton when shops are closed

One of Menton's great advantages is how much you can enjoy without buying a ticket or depending on business opening hours.

Here are several reliable ideas.

### Walk along Promenade du Soleil

Menton's seafront promenade is one of the simplest Sunday activities.

Enjoy views of the Mediterranean, Belle Époque buildings, palm trees and the changing light over the water.

The tourist office lists Promenade du Soleil as freely accessible throughout the year.

Cafés are an optional extra, not a requirement.

This makes it ideal for a Sunday morning or a public holiday when you don't want to depend on reservations.

### Explore Jardins Biovès

Near the tourist office, Jardins Biovès offers landscaped flower beds, palms, fountains and sculpture.

The tourist office lists the garden as open daily throughout the year, with free admission under normal conditions.

During the Fête du Citron, however, special event arrangements may restrict or ticket certain areas.

Outside major events, it's a straightforward short walk.

### Enjoy Esplanade des Sablettes

This is one of the best places to admire Menton's colourful old town from below.

The esplanade offers panoramic views of the buildings, basilica and Mediterranean.

The public space is listed as freely accessible year-round.

In good weather, you can spend an entire afternoon here without entering a museum, booking a tour or buying anything.

Some beach services and commercial facilities are seasonal, but the public waterfront is the main attraction.

### Explore the old-town streets

Menton's old town is beautiful on a quiet Sunday.

Walk through the lower pedestrian streets, admire the colourful buildings and explore the lanes climbing towards Saint-Michel Basilica.

The streets themselves don't depend on shop opening hours.

However, entry into churches, museums and other buildings may be affected by services, ceremonies or published schedules.

Be prepared for steep slopes and steps in the upper old town.

### Pack a picnic

A picnic may be the most dependable Sunday lunch in Menton.

Buy your ingredients on Saturday or at the morning market.

Bring bread, cheese, tomatoes, fruit and water.

Enjoy them in a suitable public picnic area or another location where eating is permitted.

Respect local rules, avoid leaving litter and don't obstruct pathways.

A picnic is particularly useful when travelling with children or when your day's timing is uncertain.
fr:
## 6. Sortir quand les boutiques sont fermées

Promenade du Soleil et Esplanade des Sablettes permettent de profiter du littoral sans dépendre d'un billet. Les cafés et services de plage sont facultatifs et parfois saisonniers. Les Jardins Biovès sont normalement un espace de promenade, mais la Fête du Citron peut modifier l'accès ou rendre certaines zones payantes.

Les rues basses et piétonnes de la vieille ville restent une autre option. Les montées vers Saint-Michel comportent pentes et marches ; l'intérieur des églises dépend des offices et cérémonies. Ce n'est pas une garantie de parcours accessible.

Un pique-nique préparé la veille ou avec les achats du marché donne de la souplesse. Choisissez un lieu où manger est autorisé, ne gênez pas les passages et remportez vos déchets. Météo, entretien et restrictions temporaires restent prioritaires, même dans les espaces publics.
it:
## 6. Uscire quando i negozi chiudono

Promenade du Soleil ed Esplanade des Sablettes permettono di godersi la costa senza biglietto. Caffè e servizi balneari sono facoltativi e talvolta stagionali. Jardins Biovès è normalmente uno spazio di passeggio, ma la Fête du Citron può limitare l'accesso o rendere alcune aree a pagamento.

Anche le vie basse pedonali del centro sono un'opzione. La salita a Saint-Michel presenta pendenze e gradini; l'interno delle chiese dipende da funzioni e cerimonie. Non è una garanzia di percorso accessibile.

Un picnic preparato prima o con acquisti al mercato offre flessibilità. Mangia dove consentito, non ostacolare passaggi e porta via i rifiuti. Meteo, manutenzione e restrizioni temporanee prevalgono anche negli spazi pubblici.
uk:
## 6. Чим зайнятися із закритими магазинами

Promenade du Soleil та Esplanade des Sablettes дозволяють насолодитися узбережжям без квитка. Кав'ярні й пляжні сервіси необов'язкові та іноді сезонні. Jardins Biovès зазвичай підходять для прогулянки, але Fête du Citron може обмежувати доступ або робити окремі зони платними.

Нижні пішохідні вулиці старого міста теж зручні. Підйом до Saint-Michel має схили й сходи; доступ усередину церков залежить від служб і церемоній. Це не обіцянка безбар'єрного маршруту.

Пікнік із заздалегідь куплених чи ринкових продуктів дає гнучкість. Їжте лише там, де дозволено, не перекривайте проходи та забирайте сміття. Погода, догляд і тимчасові заборони мають пріоритет навіть у громадських просторах.

## 7. A special Sunday experience: Dimanches piétons

Menton occasionally organises pedestrian-only Sundays along part of Promenade du Soleil.

During these events, a section of the waterfront closes to motor traffic, allowing people to enjoy a more relaxed public space.

Some editions include market stalls and activities.

But these aren't guaranteed every Sunday.

For example, the official 2026 programme included dates in May, June, September, October, November and December.

The published event calendar lists 8 November and 13 December 2026 among the upcoming editions, subject to favourable weather.

Closures can run from early Sunday morning until early Monday morning for the designated section.

Check the current event listing and traffic arrangements before planning a journey by car.

Official event page: [Pedestrian Sundays: dates and designated section](https://www.menton-riviera-merveilles.fr/offres/dimanches-pietons-menton-fr-6426314/).

## 8. Museums, gardens and attractions: don't assume Sunday closure

Sunday can actually be a good day to visit certain attractions.

For example, Val Rahmeh Botanical Garden normally opens on Sundays and closes on Tuesdays.

That illustrates why a generic rule such as “museums close on Sundays” doesn't work.

However, official seasonal hours and temporary closures take priority over the ordinary weekly schedule.

Val Rahmeh is closed from 2 through 27 November 2026 inclusive for works, according to the operator. That closure overrides the ordinary Sunday schedule, including 8, 15 and 22 November. Do not substitute another paid garden without checking its own season.

Before visiting a paid attraction, check three things:

The regular weekly schedule. Does the venue usually open on Sunday?

The seasonal calendar. Are winter hours or annual closures in effect?

The exact date. Is there a special public-holiday closure, private event or maintenance interruption?

If the visit requires advance booking, confirm an actual available session.

For an attraction-dependent itinerary, always have a free outdoor alternative.
fr:
## 8. Musées et jardins : vérifier trois niveaux

Le dimanche n'est pas automatiquement le jour de fermeture d'un musée. Val Rahmeh ouvre normalement le dimanche et ferme le mardi, mais sa fermeture pour travaux du 2 au 27 novembre 2026 inclus l'emporte sur ce rythme, notamment les 8, 15 et 22 novembre.

Vérifiez successivement le repos hebdomadaire, le calendrier saisonnier, puis la date précise et les éventuels travaux ou événements privés. Une visite guidée exige un vrai créneau disponible. Ne remplacez pas un jardin fermé par un autre sans contrôler son propre calendrier. Gardez une alternative extérieure compatible avec la météo.
it:
## 8. Musei e giardini: tre verifiche

La domenica non è automaticamente giorno di chiusura. Val Rahmeh normalmente apre la domenica e chiude il martedì, ma i lavori dal 2 al 27 novembre 2026 inclusi prevalgono sul calendario abituale, comprese le domeniche 8, 15 e 22.

Controlla riposo settimanale, stagione e data specifica con lavori o eventi privati. Una visita guidata richiede un turno realmente disponibile. Non sostituire un giardino chiuso con un altro senza verificarne il calendario. Conserva un'alternativa all'aperto compatibile con il tempo.

## 8. Музеї та сади: три рівні перевірки

Неділя не є автоматичним вихідним музею. Val Rahmeh зазвичай відкритий у неділю та закритий у вівторок, але роботи 2–27 листопада 2026 включно перекривають звичайний графік, зокрема неділі 8, 15 і 22 листопада.

Перевірте щотижневий вихідний, сезонний календар, потім конкретну дату з роботами чи приватною подією. Екскурсія потребує справді доступного сеансу. Не замінюйте закритий сад іншим без перевірки його календаря. Збережіть вуличну альтернативу за погодою.

## 9. Public transport on Sundays and holidays

Menton's location makes trips to Monaco, Nice and Ventimiglia tempting, even on Sundays.

But don't assume that weekday transport schedules apply.

### Regional trains

Check your actual journey through [SNCF Connect](https://www.sncf-connect.com/) or the relevant regional train operator.

Look at the outbound and return journeys.

A destination may be easy to reach in the morning but less convenient to return from late in the evening.

Weekend engineering works, public-holiday timetables or temporary disruptions can also affect service. Checked 5 November 2026: TER Sud's Nice–Ventimiglia works notice runs through 10 December 2027 and describes interruptions from 22:00 to 06:00 on nights Sunday–Thursday. Sunday evening is included. Check the dated journey planner, actual last return and replacement arrangements; an ordinary daytime timetable is not a late-night guarantee.

For trips into Italy, verify the operating company and international service conditions.

### Local buses

The Zest network serves Menton and nearby communities.

Use the official [Zest website](https://www.zestbus.fr/) to check Sunday and holiday service rather than relying on a weekday timetable.

Some routes may operate less frequently, and certain services may not run.

### Driving

If you're planning to drive, check road restrictions and event closures.

This is particularly important during the Lemon Festival, major Riviera events and Menton's pedestrian Sundays.

Parking access may also change during local festivities.

Our advice: For a holiday Sunday, choose one main excursion rather than constructing an itinerary with multiple tight transport connections.
fr:
## 9. Transports du dimanche et des fêtes

Pour Monaco, Nice ou Vintimille, vérifiez l'aller et le retour réels, pas seulement un horaire de semaine. L'avis TER Sud consulté le 5 novembre 2026 indique des travaux Nice–Vintimille jusqu'au 10 décembre 2027, avec interruptions de 22h à 6h les nuits du dimanche au jeudi. Le dimanche soir est donc concerné. Contrôlez les derniers trains et les substitutions pour votre date.

Les fiches Zest distinguent les jours de circulation ; certaines lignes peuvent être moins fréquentes ou absentes. Pour l'Italie, vérifiez l'opérateur et le billet approprié. En voiture, contrôlez les fermetures de voirie et accès aux parkings pendant les événements. Préférez une destination principale à plusieurs correspondances serrées.

Per Monaco, Nizza e Ventimiglia controlla andata e ritorno reali, non soltanto un orario feriale. L'avviso TER Sud consultato il 5 novembre 2026 indica lavori Nizza–Ventimiglia fino al 10 dicembre 2027, con interruzioni 22–6 nelle notti da domenica a giovedì. Anche la domenica sera è coinvolta. Le schede Zest distinguono i giorni di servizio; alcune linee possono essere meno frequenti o assenti. Per l'Italia controlla operatore e biglietto appropriato. In auto verifica viabilità e accesso ai parcheggi durante eventi. Meglio una destinazione principale che più coincidenze strette.

## 9. Недільний і святковий транспорт

Для Монако, Ніцци й Вентімільї дивіться реальну поїздку туди та назад, а не лише буденний розклад. Таблиці Zest розрізняють дні руху; окремі лінії можуть ходити рідше або не працювати. Для Італії уточнюйте перевізника й відповідний квиток. Автомобілем перевіряйте перекриття та доступ до паркування під час подій. Краще один головний напрямок, ніж кілька тісних пересадок.

## 10. What if it rains on Sunday?

Rain doesn't automatically ruin a day in Menton, but it makes opening hours more important.

An outdoor walk is easy to organise spontaneously.

A museum, workshop or indoor attraction requires a little more verification.

### Reliable rainy-day planning

Check which museums or cultural venues are genuinely open on that date.

Look for cinema screenings or indoor activities with published Sunday sessions.

Consider a long lunch if you've confirmed restaurant availability.

If you're staying in an apartment, a relaxed afternoon with food from the market, a book or a film can also be pleasant.

For families, keeping an indoor activity or simple entertainment at the apartment can be especially helpful.

Don't assume that the tourist office, a workshop or every museum will be open simply because it's raining and you need somewhere to go.
fr:
## 10. S'il pleut le dimanche

Vérifiez un musée réellement ouvert, une séance de cinéma publiée ou une activité intérieure avec réservation. La pluie n'ouvre pas les ateliers ni l'office de tourisme. Un déjeuner confirmé, un livre et un repas du marché à l'appartement peuvent aussi faire une bonne journée.

Avec des enfants, gardez une activité intérieure simple. Ne remplacez pas une visite fermée par une autre dont le calendrier n'a pas été contrôlé.
it:
## 10. Se piove di domenica

Scegli un museo realmente aperto, una proiezione pubblicata o un'attività interna prenotabile. La pioggia non apre laboratori o uffici turistici. Un pranzo confermato, un libro e un pasto del mercato in appartamento possono essere un buon programma.

Con bambini tieni un'attività semplice al coperto. Non sostituire una visita chiusa con un'altra non verificata.
uk:
## 10. Якщо в неділю дощ

Оберіть музей із підтвердженою роботою, опублікований кіносеанс або доступне для бронювання заняття в приміщенні. Дощ не відкриває майстерні чи туристичні офіси. Підтверджений обід, книжка й ринкові продукти в апартаментах теж можуть скласти приємний день.

З дітьми залиште просту домашню активність. Не замінюйте закриту пам'ятку іншою без перевірки.

## 11. What about pharmacies and other essentials?

Not every Sunday problem concerns sightseeing.

You might need medicine, baby supplies or something you've forgotten to buy.

### Pharmacies

French pharmacies operate a duty system for periods outside normal opening hours.

The pharmacy on duty may change depending on the date, time and area.

Don't rely on a permanently published list of “Sunday pharmacies.”

Check the local duty pharmacy information for your specific date or contact a nearby pharmacy for instructions.

Some duty services operate behind closed doors and require a particular access procedure.

For a medical emergency, call 112. This is access information, not medical advice; do not delay urgent care while searching for a shop or duty rota.

### Baby supplies and household essentials

If you're travelling with a baby, buy enough nappies, formula and other essential supplies before a major holiday.

The same applies to specific dietary products, pet food and other items that may not be stocked by small convenience shops.

Even when a supermarket is open, it may not carry your preferred brand.

### Apartment arrival on a Sunday

If you're checking into an apartment on Sunday, confirm the check-in instructions, access code or key collection arrangements in advance.

Ask whether the property provides initial supplies such as toilet paper, washing-up liquid and coffee.

That makes the first evening easier, particularly if you arrive after local supermarkets have closed.
fr:
## 11. Pharmacie et besoins essentiels

La pharmacie de garde change selon date, heure et secteur. Demandez la procédure à une officine locale ou consultez l'information de garde actuelle ; ne retenez pas une liste permanente de pharmacies « ouvertes le dimanche ». Certaines gardes nécessitent un accès particulier, portes fermées.

En urgence médicale, appelez le 112 et ne retardez pas les secours pour chercher un commerce. Ce guide ne donne pas de conseil médical. Achetez avant une grande fête les médicaments nécessaires, couches, lait infantile et produits spécifiques. Une supérette ouverte ne garantit pas votre référence.

Pour une arrivée le dimanche, confirmez avec l'hôte la remise des clés et les fournitures de départ. Les instructions privées et codes restent dans l'échange personnel, pas sur cette page.
it:
## 11. Farmacia e necessità essenziali

La farmacia di turno cambia con data, ora e zona. Chiedi istruzioni a una farmacia locale o consulta le informazioni di turno attuali; non memorizzare un elenco permanente di «farmacie domenicali». Alcuni turni sono a porte chiuse con procedura specifica.

Per emergenze mediche chiama il 112 senza ritardare i soccorsi per cercare un negozio. Non sono consigli medici. Prima di una festa importante acquista farmaci necessari, pannolini, latte infantile e prodotti particolari. Un minimarket aperto non garantisce la tua marca.

Per arrivare domenica concorda prima chiavi e dotazioni iniziali con l'host. Istruzioni private e codici restano nella comunicazione personale, non in questa pagina.
uk:
## 11. Аптека й необхідні речі

Чергова аптека змінюється за датою, часом і районом. Запитайте порядок доступу в місцевій аптеці або перевірте нинішню інформацію про чергування; постійний список «недільних аптек» ненадійний. Деякі чергування проходять за зачиненими дверима за окремою процедурою.

У медичній невідкладній ситуації телефонуйте 112 і не відкладайте допомогу через пошук магазину. Це не медична порада. Перед великим святом купіть необхідні ліки, підгузки, дитяче харчування та спеціальні продукти. Відкритий мінімаркет не гарантує потрібної марки.

Для недільного заселення завчасно погодьте ключі та початкові запаси з господарем. Приватні інструкції й коди залишаються в особистому спілкуванні, не на цій сторінці.

en:
## 12. How to check opening hours properly

Online opening hours are useful, but they aren't always current.

For a normal weekday, a map listing may be sufficient for casual plans.

For Sunday dinner or Christmas Day, use a more reliable process.

### Step 1: Start with the business's own website

Look for the official opening schedule and any holiday notice.

A store chain's branch page is more useful than the chain's general homepage.

### Step 2: Check the exact date

A business may list normal Sunday hours but have a separate exception for 1 November, 11 November or Christmas.

Look for terms such as horaires exceptionnels or jours fériés.

### Step 3: Check reservations or booking availability

For restaurants and ticketed attractions, an active booking system may give more useful information than general opening hours.

However, a page saying “open” doesn't guarantee that there are tables or tickets available.

### Step 4: Call when it really matters

If you're travelling a long distance, relying on accessible facilities or arranging an important meal, telephone confirmation is sensible.

Here's a useful French question:

“Bonjour, êtes-vous ouverts dimanche prochain ? Et est-ce que vous servez le dîner ?”

Meaning: “Hello, are you open next Sunday? And do you serve dinner?”

For public holidays, replace dimanche prochain with the specific date.

### Step 5: Keep a backup

If your first-choice restaurant is closed, you should already know whether you'll cook, order takeaway from a confirmed provider or visit another restaurant.

For attractions, keep a coastal walk or garden visit as your alternative.

The best Sunday itinerary isn't the one with the most places supposedly open.

It's the one that still works when one of them isn't.
fr:
## 12. Bien vérifier un horaire

Commencez par la page officielle du magasin précis, puis cherchez les horaires exceptionnels de la date. Contrôlez un service de dîner ou un créneau de visite, pas seulement la mention « ouvert ». Téléphonez si un trajet important, un besoin d'accessibilité ou un repas essentiel en dépend.

Question utile : « Bonjour, êtes-vous ouverts dimanche prochain ? Et est-ce que vous servez le dîner ? » Pour une fête, remplacez dimanche prochain par la date. Enfin, prévoyez un autre restaurant confirmé ou un repas à l'appartement, et une promenade si une attraction ferme. Une carte en ligne est un indice, pas une confirmation suffisante pour Noël.
it:
## 12. Verificare bene gli orari

Parti dalla pagina ufficiale della filiale precisa, poi cerca le eccezioni della data. Verifica cena o turno di visita, non soltanto «aperto». Telefona se dipendono dalla visita un viaggio lungo, esigenze di accessibilità o un pasto importante.

Domanda utile: «Bonjour, êtes-vous ouverts dimanche prochain ? Et est-ce que vous servez le dîner ?» Significa: siete aperti domenica prossima e servite la cena? Per una festa sostituisci dimanche prochain con la data. Prepara infine un altro locale confermato o una cena in appartamento e una passeggiata se chiude l'attrazione. La mappa online è un indizio, non una conferma sufficiente per Natale.

## 12. Як правильно перевірити години

Почніть з офіційної сторінки конкретної філії, потім знайдіть винятки на потрібну дату. Перевіряйте вечерю чи сеанс, не просто слово «відкрито». Зателефонуйте, якщо від цього залежать довга поїздка, доступність або важливий прийом їжі.

Корисне запитання: «Bonjour, êtes-vous ouverts dimanche prochain ? Et est-ce que vous servez le dîner ?» Тобто: чи працюєте наступної неділі та чи подаєте вечерю? Для свята замініть dimanche prochain конкретною датою. Залиште інший підтверджений ресторан або їжу вдома, а також прогулянку замість закритої пам'ятки. Онлайн-карта є підказкою, але не достатнім підтвердженням на Різдво.

## 13. Three easy Sunday plans

### Plan A: The relaxed Mediterranean Sunday

Start with coffee and breakfast at your apartment or a confirmed open bakery.

Visit Les Halles during its morning trading period.

Walk through the lower town towards the seafront.

Enjoy a long lunch at a restaurant you've reserved.

Spend the afternoon on Promenade du Soleil or at Les Sablettes.

Return to the apartment for a light dinner.

Why it works: Only the market and restaurant depend on business hours. The rest of the day is flexible.

### Plan B: A Sunday with almost no opening-hour dependencies

Prepare breakfast and a picnic from groceries purchased the previous day.

Walk through Jardins Biovès and towards the waterfront.

Explore Promenade du Soleil and the lower pedestrian streets.

Enjoy lunch outdoors in an appropriate location.

Spend the afternoon admiring the old town from Esplanade des Sablettes.

Cook dinner in your apartment.

Why it works: The plan depends primarily on public spaces and weather rather than commercial opening hours.

### Plan C: A Sunday excursion

Choose Monaco, Nice or Ventimiglia.

Check the outbound and return train services.

Plan one main activity and verify its Sunday opening.

Book lunch if you want a particular restaurant.

Return to Menton without making your evening dependent on a late connection.

Why it works: It avoids the common mistake of scheduling too many destinations around reduced transport services.

## 13. Trois programmes simples

### A. Dimanche méditerranéen

Petit déjeuner à l'appartement ou dans une boulangerie confirmée, Halles le matin, rues basses, déjeuner réservé, puis Soleil ou Sablettes. Dîner léger chez vous. Seuls le marché et le restaurant imposent leurs horaires.

### B. Très peu de dépendances commerciales

Provisions la veille, petit déjeuner et pique-nique préparés, Biovès si accessible, bord de mer et rues basses, pause autorisée pour manger, vue depuis Sablettes, dîner à l'appartement. Le programme dépend surtout du temps et des règles locales.

### C. Une excursion

Une seule destination parmi Monaco, Nice ou Vintimille. Confirmez aller, retour et activité principale ; réservez le déjeuner souhaité. Évitez de faire dépendre le dîner d'une dernière correspondance incertaine.
it:
## 13. Tre programmi semplici

### A. Domenica mediterranea

Colazione in appartamento o in panetteria confermata, Halles al mattino, vie basse, pranzo prenotato, poi Soleil o Sablettes. Cena leggera a casa. Solo mercato e ristorante impongono orari.

### B. Poche dipendenze commerciali

Spesa il giorno prima, colazione e picnic pronti, Biovès se accessibile, lungomare e vie basse, sosta autorizzata per mangiare, panorama dalle Sablettes e cena in appartamento. Il programma dipende soprattutto da tempo e regole locali.

### C. Un'escursione

Una destinazione fra Monaco, Nizza e Ventimiglia. Conferma andata, ritorno e attività principale, prenota il pranzo desiderato. Non fare dipendere la cena da un'ultima coincidenza incerta.

## 13. Три прості плани

### А. Середземноморська неділя

Сніданок вдома або в підтвердженій пекарні, Halles уранці, нижні вулиці, заброньований обід, потім Soleil чи Sablettes. Легка вечеря в апартаментах. Час обмежують лише ринок і ресторан.

### Б. Мінімальна залежність від магазинів

Продукти напередодні, готовий сніданок і пікнік, Biovès за доступності, набережна й нижні вулиці, дозволене місце для їжі, краєвид із Sablettes та вечеря вдома. План залежить передусім від погоди й місцевих правил.

### В. Одна поїздка

Оберіть Монако, Ніццу або Вентімілью. Підтвердьте шлях туди, назад і головне заняття; забронюйте бажаний обід. Не робіть вечерю залежною від останньої непевної пересадки.

## 14. The day-before checklist

Before going to bed on Saturday or the evening before a public holiday, take five minutes to review your plan.

- Do you have breakfast ingredients?

- Is there enough food for one backup meal?

- Have you confirmed any restaurant reservation?

- Is your chosen attraction actually open on the date?

- Have you checked both outbound and return transport?

- Do you have essential medicines and supplies?

- Is there a simple alternative if weather or opening hours change?

You don't need to control every detail.

You just need to remove the few uncertainties that could interrupt the day.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is everything closed in Menton on Sunday?

No. The covered market normally operates on Sunday mornings, some supermarkets open and restaurants may serve lunch or dinner. Individual businesses follow their own schedules.

### Is Menton's covered market open on Sunday?

The municipality publishes daily opening from 7:30 a.m. to 1 p.m., including Sundays. Individual stall availability and holiday exceptions may vary.

### Can I buy groceries on Sunday evening in Menton?

Some convenience supermarkets publish evening Sunday hours, including certain Carrefour City branches. Check the exact branch and any exceptional holiday schedule before travelling.

### Are restaurants open on Sunday night?

Some are, but not all. A restaurant may serve Sunday lunch and close in the evening. Confirm dinner service and reserve when appropriate.

### What can I do in Menton if shops are closed?

Explore Promenade du Soleil, Jardins Biovès, the lower town and Esplanade des Sablettes. These public spaces don't normally depend on commercial opening hours, although weather and special events can affect access.

### Is 1 May different from other French public holidays?

Yes. Labour Day has special legal protections as a non-working day, so visitors should prepare for wider closures and organise essential purchases beforehand.

### Do trains run on Sundays?

Regional trains operate on Sundays, but timetables and frequencies can differ. Check the actual journey, including your return, before departure.

### Is Menton a good destination for a Sunday visit?

Yes. Its waterfront, gardens and historic streets make it rewarding even without a full programme of shops and attractions.

## Questions fréquentes

### Tout est-il fermé le dimanche ?

Non : marché le matin, certains magasins et restaurants, selon leurs propres horaires.

### Les Halles ouvrent-elles ?

La Ville publie tous les jours 7h30–13h ; commerçants et exceptions restent à vérifier.

### Peut-on faire les courses le soir ?

Certaines supérettes publient des heures tardives. Confirmez le magasin et la date.

### Les restaurants servent-ils le dimanche soir ?

Certains oui ; un déjeuner ouvert n'implique pas un dîner.

### Que faire quand les commerces ferment ?

Soleil, Biovès, rues basses et Sablettes, sous réserve de météo et restrictions.

### Le 1er mai est-il différent ?

Oui, ses règles particulières justifient d'anticiper les fermetures et les achats essentiels.

### Les trains circulent-ils ?

Oui avec variations ; l'avis de travaux inclut les nuits du dimanche. Vérifiez le trajet réel.

### Menton vaut-il une visite dominicale ?

Oui, le littoral et les rues historiques permettent une journée souple sans programme de boutiques.

## Domande frequenti

### È tutto chiuso la domenica?

No: mercato al mattino, alcuni negozi e ristoranti con i propri orari.

### Les Halles apre?

Il Comune pubblica tutti i giorni 7:30–13; banchi ed eccezioni restano da verificare.

### Si può fare la spesa la sera?

Alcuni minimarket pubblicano aperture serali. Conferma filiale e data.

### I ristoranti servono domenica sera?

Alcuni sì, ma apertura a pranzo non implica cena.

### Che fare con i negozi chiusi?

Soleil, Biovès, vie basse e Sablettes, salvo meteo e restrizioni.

### Il 1° maggio è diverso?

Sì, le tutele particolari richiedono di anticipare acquisti e chiusure.

### I treni circolano?

Sì con variazioni; l'avviso lavori include le notti domenicali. Controlla il viaggio reale.

### Mentone merita una visita domenicale?

Sì: costa e vie storiche permettono una giornata flessibile senza programma di shopping.

## Поширені запитання

### Чи все зачинено в неділю?

Ні: ринок уранці, частина магазинів і ресторанів за власними графіками.

### Чи відкритий Les Halles?

Місто публікує щодня 7:30–13:00; продавців і винятки треба уточнювати.

### Чи можна купити продукти ввечері?

Деякі мінімаркети публікують вечірні години. Перевірте філію та дату.

### Чи подають недільну вечерю?

Деякі ресторани так, але обід не означає вечерю.

### Що робити із зачиненими магазинами?

Soleil, Biovès, нижні вулиці та Sablettes, з урахуванням погоди й обмежень.

### Чи відрізняється 1 травня?

Так, особливі правила вимагають раніше подбати про необхідні покупки й закриття.

### Чи ходять потяги?

Так зі змінами; оголошення робіт охоплює недільні ночі. Перевірте конкретну поїздку.

### Чи варто їхати до Ментона в неділю?

Так: узбережжя й історичні вулиці дають гнучкий день без шопінгу.

## Final thoughts: let Sunday be Sunday

Sunday in Menton doesn't need to be complicated.

You might find yourself shopping at the market, enjoying a long lunch or discovering a quieter section of the seafront.

On a public holiday, you may encounter more closed doors than usual.

But the Mediterranean will still be there.

The best approach is to plan the practical things early, confirm the few businesses that matter and leave the rest of the day open.

Buy your breakfast ingredients, organise dinner, check your transport and choose a walk you can enjoy without an admission ticket.

Then relax.

A slow Sunday is part of the Riviera experience, not a problem that needs solving.

## Laisser au dimanche son rythme

Préparez les repas importants, confirmez quelques horaires et laissez le reste ouvert. Le marché, un déjeuner ou une promenade tranquille peuvent suffire. Un dimanche lent fait partie du séjour ; il n'exige pas une liste d'établissements prétendument toujours ouverts.

## Lascia alla domenica il suo ritmo

Prepara i pasti importanti, conferma pochi orari e lascia il resto aperto. Mercato, pranzo o passeggiata tranquilla possono bastare. Una domenica lenta fa parte del soggiorno, senza bisogno di un elenco di attività presumibilmente sempre aperte.
